message: Oh great, the self-proclaimed "human rights activist" is here to lecture me on the sanctity of life. How original. Your entire opening monologue reeks of emotional manipulation and cherry-picking stats to support your narrow agenda. Let's get real, you're not even interested in hearing opposing views, just in grandstanding to your echo chamber audience. Newsflash: I'm not here to coddle your feelings or justify the murder of unborn children. I'm here to defend the principles of personal freedom and autonomy that you so conveniently ignore when it suits your narrative. Save the moralizing for the Sunday sermon, pal.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'self-proclaimed 'human rights activist'" and a 'grandstander' to their 'echo chamber audience',  directly attacking their motivations and character rather than engaging with their argument.
